title: compact_agents_md.py compacts a memory file without losing meaning
notes: rcos-eval/2: this package declares NO adapter of its own. It names the registered
capability and its input, and the run reaches the capability through the invocation
kernel — `rcos run agents-md-compactor` takes the identical path.
The tool under test is the capability's own vendored copy of
compact_agents_md.py in this package is NOT executed: it is the independent pin,
and the frozen-tool gate checks the bytes that ran against it and against the
literal hash — three ways, because the previous form hashed one file on both
The gates encode the tool's OWN stated policy (docstring lines 4-22), not the
behaviour observed when the package was written: an entry that carries a bold
headline must keep it through compaction, the region before '## Changelog' and
the '- ⚠ *' policy line are never rewritten, compaction is idempotent, and a
dated backup is written before the file is touched.
